challenge.method: Read the GPLv2 text, its sample application notice and the two paragraphs after the final separator. Test whether any of these makes the exception package-wide.
challenge.results: The exception expressly limits linking to portions and permits a modifier to extend or remove it. Its final instruction even contemplates removal from every source file. The GPL sample notice supplies no contrary project declaration.
